title: From Reward Engineering to Data-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Effective Agentic Visual Tool Use
abstract: arXiv:2611.28558v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly use external visual tools to acquire evidence during reasoning, yet learning when to invoke these tools remains challenging. Existing tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) methods often rely on call-contingent rewards to encourage beneficial tool use, but such reward engineering can distort the task objective and lead to degenerate calling behaviors. We argue that effective tool-use learning requires identifying not merely which questions are difficult, but which failures are attributable to missing visual evidence and can therefore be corrected through tool observations. We propose AOVO, a data-centric framework that enables MLLMs to learn effective tool use through perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS), without introducing tool-specific rewards. tldr: 该论文提出 AOVO 框架，通过感知归因和策略自适应数据采样（PADS）实现以数据为中心的强化学习，无需依赖奖励工程即可让多模态大语言模型学会有效地调用视觉工具。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AOVO, a data-centric reinforcement learning framework that leverages perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS) to enable MLLMs to learn effective visual tool use without relying on reward engineering.
